Forge.description: The town's furnace-heart, all heat and hammer-song.
Forge.purpose: Smelts scrap into parts and keeps every other building in town repairable.

Rock and Roll House.description: A music hall with a neon guitar over the door and sawdust on the floor.
Rock and Roll House.purpose: The town's joy engine - house band, dances, and songs that carry the chronicle further than paper ever could.

Library.description: A cool, quiet hall where the chronicle is bound and shelved.
Library.purpose: Stores the town's memory; every discovery and ruling ends up catalogued here.

Neon Sign.description: The great roadside sign, rebuilt tube by tube.
Neon Sign.purpose: The town's beacon; its brightness is the town's pulse, visible for miles down the highway.

Observatory.description: A dome on the high ground, lenses pointed at a huge desert sky.
Observatory.purpose: Watches weather, signals, and the phase drift of the double helix.

Water Tower.description: A riveted tank on tall legs, painted with a white star.
Water Tower.purpose: Stores the town's water and doubles as the Explorers' lookout.

Courthouse.description: Adobe walls, a brass bell, and the town charter under glass.
Courthouse.purpose: Where disputes get heard and the three-strike rulings get recorded.

Route 66 Diner.description: Chrome stools, a jukebox, and pie that never runs out.
Route 66 Diner.purpose: Feeds every shift and hosts the counter talk where half the town's plans are born.

Trading Post.description: Crates, coffee, and a chalkboard of who is owed what.
Trading Post.purpose: Runs barter and the treasury; every credit in town passes across its counter.

Chapel.description: A small white chapel where the highway bends.
Chapel.purpose: Quiet ground for weddings, memorials, and keeping the creed.

Motorcycle Garage.description: Lifts, tool walls, and a row of bikes in mid-repair.
Motorcycle Garage.purpose: Keeps the town's wheels turning; riders roll in broken and roll out blessed.

Core / Forge District.description: The working heart - fire, water, and wheels; where the town's power and repairs come from.

Civic / Knowledge District.description: The remembering heart - memory, sky, faith, law, and song; where the town keeps what it knows and what it loves.

Strip / Route 66 District.description: The bright mile - neon, food, and trade; the town's front door, where the road comes in.
